items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: And after Valto come Tinette. Now Tinette was, uh, Tinette was a violin player too. He was good.

ctx.x: He was a good violin player too.

I'm telling you, Manu Mineta could play a good violin. And he, I think, uh, now I say, I'll say it like this. Jim Apala was the leader. Say, Manu Mineta came second. Then Peter Bocos behind him. I think that, I rate him like that. Yeah. Then, then after the hat, after that come, uh, come, uh, uh, Valto. And after Valto come Tinette. Now Tinette was, uh, Tinette was a violin player too. He was good. Uh-huh. Yeah. You heard of him? I don't remember that, man. No, Tinette, yeah. Well, that's the, that's the one.…
